summary.title: Postgres Locks Explained
summary.one_liner: A site covering how PostgreSQL table and row locks work, with examples, an interactive lock blocking graph, troubleshooting guidance, and monitoring tool reviews.
takeaways: Conceptual explanation of how locks work in Postgres, with animations to aid understanding
Table-level lock behavior demonstrated through runnable examples
An interactive Lock Blocking Graph shows which SQL operations block each other
Guidance on identifying and resolving common lock problems
Reviews of popular Postgres monitoring tools and some homegrown approaches
summary.summary: The site is a personal documentation project by a customer reliability engineer focused on Postgres management and observability. It is organized into sections: Concept (lock basics with animations), Locks By Example (table locks with runnable demos), Lock Blocking Graph (an interactive tool showing which SQL operations block each other), Troubleshooting (identifying and resolving lock problems), and Monitoring (reviews of monitoring tools and homegrown solutions). The author notes that conceptual explanation, monitoring tool reviews, and troubleshooting are still planned topics.
